name: audit-log
title: Audit log
description: Every event on one row: time, who, action, what (with before and after values), result and IP. Search, an action filter and a failed count on top.
htmlExample: <bef-audit-log class="w-full max-w-xl" :entries='[{"id":"1","actor":"Meera Iyer","action":"updated","target":"Salary structure, Engineering","at":"~now-30m","ip":"10.0.4.21","changes":[{"field":"Basic","from":"₹60,000","to":"₹64,000"},{"field":"HRA","from":"₹24,000","to":"₹25,600"},{"field":"Effective from","from":"","to":"01 Nov 2026"}]},{"id":"2","actor":"Isha Nair","action":"created","target":"Employee EMP-0412","at":"~now-3h","ip":"10.0.4.18","changes":[{"field":"Name","to":"Ananya Kulkarni"},{"field":"Department","to":"Engineering"}]},{"id":"3","actor":"Kabir Shah","action":"exported","target":"Payroll report, September","at":"~now-20h","ip":"10.0.7.5"},{"id":"4","actor":"Rohan Das","action":"deleted","target":"Draft offer letter v1","at":"~now-30h","ip":"10.0.4.33"},{"id":"5","actor":"Aarav Mehta","action":"updated","target":"Leave policy 2026","at":"~now-2d","ip":"10.0.4.2","changes":[{"field":"Carry-forward cap","from":"10 days","to":"12 days"}]}]'></bef-audit-log>
